ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a contour topographic map, in which multiple contour lines and elevation labels such as “50” and “150” can be seen; the relatively thick black curve indicates the river. Point A is located slightly to the right of the middle of the figure, and point C is located in the lower-left part of the figure; C is southwest of A. Then reason: According to the principle that rivers should flow from high places to low places, combined with the elevation changes of the contour lines near the AC river section, it can be judged that the lower end of the AC section is near C, so the river flows from near A to near C. Since C is southwest of A, the approximate flow direction of the river section between AC is toward the southwest.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the contour topographic map of a certain region, and answer accordingly:

<image1>

In the river section between AC in the figure, where is the approximate flow direction of the river?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the contour map, the bold river, and points A and C. Use the contour labels around the river to compare relative elevation near A and near C. Since the river must flow downhill and the lower part of the AC reach lies toward C, infer that water flows from A toward C. Because C is southwest of A on the map, conclude the river flow direction is approximately southwest.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一幅等高线地形图，能看到多条等高线及“50”“150”等高程标注；较粗的黑色曲线表示河流。点A位于图中部偏右，点C位于图中左下部，C在A的西南方向。再推理：根据河流应由高处流向低处的原则，结合AC河段附近等高线高低变化，可判断AC段较低的一端在C附近，因此河流从A附近流向C附近。由于C位于A的西南方，所以河流AC之间河段的大致流向为向西南。

method.CoT_qualify_0: 该推理基本符合题意、标准答案和方法草稿：先描述了等高线图、河流及A/C位置，再依据河流由高处流向低处推断由A流向C，最终得出向西南。建议小幅完善：在“AC段较低的一端在C附近”处可更明确说明是依据河谷处等高线弯曲方向或附近等高线数值变化判断，以增强可验证性。

planner_metadata.image_role: From the image, locate the bold river segment between labels A and C. Note that A is on the upper/right side of this segment and C is on the lower/left side. Read the nearby contour labels and contour arrangement: the area around A/B is associated with higher ground/contours than the downstream valley toward C/D, while the channel descends toward the lower-left.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text asks specifically for the approximate flow direction of the river reach between A and C.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: On a topographic map, rivers flow from higher elevation to lower elevation. Map north is conventionally upward unless otherwise indicated, so lower-left corresponds to southwest.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: locate the bold AC river reach and observe the bends of the contour lines around the channel. Apply the rule that contour-line V shapes point upstream. The upstream direction is indicated toward the A/B side, so the downstream flow is from A toward C. Since that direction on the map is toward the lower-left, state that the river flows approximately southwest.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一幅等高线地形图，粗黑线标出了河流河段，A位于图中偏中右位置，C位于图中偏左下位置，AC之间的河段整体从A附近向左下方延伸到C附近。河道附近的等高线在穿过河谷处呈弯曲的“V”形。
推理：等高线穿越河谷时，“V”形尖端指向上游。图中河道附近等高线的弯曲显示上游方向在A/B一侧，因此河流应从A附近流向C附近。按地图通常上北下南、左西右东判断，从A到C的大致方向是左下方，即西南方向。
结论：河流AC之间的河段大致向西南流。
